$comment: Board status per ticket for scripts/github-project/sync-project.mjs. Values: Todo | In Progress | Done. Unlisted tickets are Todo. Update this file when a task finishes, then re-run the script.

ownerIssues.title: Merge epic PRs in order: VW-E1 → VW-E2 → VW-E3
ownerIssues.body: Open pull requests from `epic/VW-E1-foundation`, then `epic/VW-E2-brand-design`, then `epic/VW-E3-core-pages` into `epic/vfpscanner-web-implementation`. Each branch is stacked on the previous one. Wait for CI to pass, then merge with **Create a merge commit** (not squash), as in `docs/EXECUTION-RULES.md` §8.

ownerIssues.title: Review defaults and placeholders before launch
ownerIssues.body:
Written as defaults in VW-E3 and listed in `docs/tasks/todo.md` ("Owner review before launch"):

- [ ] Assessment process: kick-off call ~45 min, questions in writing, you keep the report (`frontend/content/pages/assessment.mdx`)
- [ ] "We can work under your NDA" (assessment, FAQ, contact)
- [ ] Retainer contents (`retainer.mdx`)
- [ ] About page wording (`about.mdx`)
- [ ] Draft prices (D3): `docs/PRICING.md` + `frontend/lib/pricing.ts`
- [ ] Legal templates: fill every [placeholder] in `frontend/content/pages/legal/*.mdx`, then set `template: false`

ownerIssues.title: Scanner: move to .NET 10 and publish a self-contained Windows exe (D8)
ownerIssues.body: .NET 8 reaches end of support on 10 November 2026. Retarget `VfpScanner.csproj` to `net10.0` and publish `vfpscan.exe` as a single self-contained file, so users need nothing installed. The free-scan page says the download "will be" a single file; this must be true before VW-031 opens the download.
